# Convert ASCII codes without rounding I64

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

The numeric overload preserves the exact I64 Array schema and order. ASCII codes 97 and 122 become 65 and 90; the unrelated exact integer 9007199254740993 remains unchanged.
